=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:423 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The newly extracted scripts were added to `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`, which can break consumer repos pinned to older `script_ref` versions that do not yet contain those files.
  WHY: All reviewers identified this as a backward-compatibility break that will hard-fail bootstrap for affected consumers, and the highest severity/confidence is retained.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:161-182 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `git hash-object` errors are masked, so a file that disappears or becomes unreadable during touched-file detection can produce an empty SHA and be skipped.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers described the same root cause and runtime effect: silent hashing failure can omit legitimate touched files and lose editor changes.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:34 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Sourcing `gh_helpers.sh` with `|| true` masks missing-helper or path failures.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this defers the failure into later undefined-function errors instead of stopping with a clear bootstrap error.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:304-381 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python overlap-validation heredoc lacks explicit exception handling for file I/O or subprocess failures.
  WHY: The same missing-error-handling root cause is reported across reviewers; the disagreement is only on how hard it fails, so the highest severity/confidence is kept.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:945-951 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `partial` mode, skipping the last alias causes single-alias cases to return no GraphQL data.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same off-by-one/skip behavior and its effect on single-issue partial cases, so the findings are merged.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:441 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The script uses `GH_PAT` without validating that it is non-empty before constructing the git remote URL.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently flagged the missing guard; the consensus is low severity because the failure is later and conditional on misconfiguration.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:154 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The allowlist `grep -Fxq` check does not use `--`, so a touched path beginning with `-` could be misparsed as an option.
  WHY: This was raised only by one reviewer as a defensive bug; it remains a singleton finding in consensus.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:418-422 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` detection relies on a single `git diff-tree` check against `HEAD`.
  WHY: This was reported once as a fragile detection pattern; no other reviewer endorsed it, so it remains a singleton.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:153 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Some `git` calls in the `T` branch use `diff_path` without fully guarding against option-like filenames.
  WHY: This was presented only as a hardening suggestion with low confidence, so it stays separate and low severity.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:915 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The regex used to detect batched issue aliases is brittle and tied to the current alias naming convention.
  WHY: Two reviewers independently raised the same test fragility, but no runtime production bug was claimed.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:275-284 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The integration-sync `gh api` calls lack an explicit `GH_PAT` guard before invoking authenticated retries.
  WHY: This is a singleton finding; it overlaps conceptually with the GH_PAT validation issue but targets a different code path and failure mode.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:350-362 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The overlap-validation Python heredoc lacks exception handling, so inaccessible inputs can crash the validation path.
  WHY: This is a singleton finding describing the same class of error as the broader Python I/O issue, but with a narrower line range from that reviewer.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:154 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The allowlist `grep -Fxq` check can mis-handle touched paths that begin with `-`.
  WHY: Singleton hardening issue; kept distinct because only one reviewer reported it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:423 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: New scripts added to `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` will break consumer repos pinned to older versions.
  WHY: Consumer repos will fail during bootstrap with missing required script errors, breaking the review/autofix pipeline.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:951 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In `partial` mode, mock skips last alias, causing single-issue cases to return no data.
  WHY: Poller tests with single issues in partial mode will receive empty data, potentially causing test failures or masking real issues.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:182 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git hash-object` errors are masked with `2>/dev/null || true`.
  WHY: File disappearance or permission issues during SHA comparison will be silently ignored, potentially causing incorrect change detection.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:34 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Sourcing `gh_helpers.sh` with `|| true` masks failures.
  WHY: Missing helper file causes confusing `command not found` errors later instead of clear sourcing failure.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:911 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Regex pattern is too specific to current alias naming convention.
  WHY: If alias pattern changes in production, tests may fail to detect batch queries, causing test failures.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:441 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Script assumes `GH_PAT` is set without validation.
  WHY: Empty GH_PAT causes git remote URL rewrite to fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:423 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new scripts (`review_commit_changes.sh`, `review_conflict_prepare.sh`, `review_conflict_resolve.sh`) are declared in `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`.
  WHY: Consumer repositories pinned to the `@stable` channel or an older commit will fail at bootstrap because these files do not yet exist in their local checkouts.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:161 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git hash-object -- "${diff_path}" 2>/dev/null` masks potential errors without verification.
  WHY: If a file is deleted between the `while` loop listing and the `hash-object` call, `new_sha` becomes an empty string and file deletion may be skipped by the touched-file detector.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:350-362 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The overlap validation Python heredoc lacks exception handling for file reads.
  WHY: If `last_run_diff_path` or `staged_cmd` fail or the files are inaccessible, the Python process will exit with an unhandled exception.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:275-284 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: GitHub API calls are issued during integration sync without verification that `GH_PAT` is populated.
  WHY: If `GH_PAT` is missing, `gh_retry` will fail to authenticate and burn retry attempts before falling back.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:418-422 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` detection logic relies on a single `git diff-tree` call against `HEAD`.
  WHY: This assumes the commit just created is exactly what `HEAD` points to and is fragile in a multi-commit or parallel environment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
